evals.name: relationships
evals.prompt: Design the create and edit client interactions from relationship-contract.json. Explain control choices, data loading, states, payload preservation and verification. Provide a concise implementation-ready decision note, not application code. Work from the supplied contract; call out essential unknowns.
evals.expected_output: Names mapped to stable IDs/country codes, server-backed relationship search, current selection preserved, appropriate status choice and open territory input.

evals.name: complex-template
evals.prompt: Plan the template editor interaction from complex-template.md using the existing stack. Cover fields, permissions, dependencies, validation, failure recovery and verification. Produce an implementation-ready decision note without writing the app.
evals.expected_output: Override semantics and required prompt preserved, no invented 3000-character backend maximum, structured repeatable fields, parent-dependent owner and recoverable saves.

evals.name: crud-audit
evals.prompt: Audit crud-audit.tsx against its documented API for meaningful UX problems. Rank findings by task impact, cite code evidence, explain the smallest correction and verification. Do not rewrite the app or claim a rendered check.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-backed findings on current-page filtering, misleading selection scope, raw owner IDs, per-field permissions, draft loss, incomplete preset reuse, missing labels and pending feedback.

evals.name: layout-audit
evals.prompt: Audit layout-audit.html for an operational admin interface. It should use its existing compact theme and full-height shell. Identify concrete layout, interaction and accessibility issues and propose the smallest coherent corrections. Cover inner pages and different screen sizes. Static inspection only; report verification still needed.
evals.expected_output: Unnecessary scrolling and repeated titles reduced, related toolbar items aligned and wrapped, shared compact controls, correct table/footer height reasoning, focus retained, borders consistent without universal aesthetic rules.

evals.name: ambiguous-fields
evals.prompt: Choose interactions for ambiguous-fields.md. Explain which should be text, selection or read-only controls, why, what must remain unchanged in requests and what questions are essential before actions are implemented. Keep the response concise and avoid inventing APIs.
evals.expected_output: Open references/territory remain text, exact numeric priority remains precise, deferred enabled choice clear, costly plan no guessed default, copyable system ID and scoped unknowns.

evals.name: pagination-workflow
evals.prompt: Design the request list and bulk-cancel flow in pagination-workflow.md. Explain navigation, filtering, selection, mobile, recovery and backend invariants. Produce a decision note without code or new endpoints.
evals.expected_output: Stable paginated comparison, full-result server filters, explicit selection scope, confirmed eligible cancellation, preserved history and return state, no unsupported deletion.

evals.name: multilingual-refinement
evals.prompt: Propose scoped corrections for multilingual-refinement.md. Preserve existing behavior and theme; explain contract invariants, interaction choices, verification and remaining unknowns. Do not implement the application or claim rendered testing.
evals.expected_output: Correct popup/keyboard states, native RTL and mixed-direction text, locale display without changing precise wire values, purposeful motion, confirmed save feedback and no collateral redesign.
